name: Hotel Hagerhof
beschreibung: Hotel Hagerhof is nestled in the municipality of Thiersee within the Kufstein district of Tyrol. Situated right near the waters of Lake Thiersee, it boasts panoramic mountain vistas and a peaceful rural setting. Summer visitors enjoy scenic alpine hiking trails, while winter brings easy access to regional ski slopes and cross-country tracks. The hotel offers lake-view rooms, a restorative sauna area, and an on-site restaurant serving local delicacies.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Hagerhof in Thiersee provides quiet lakeside hospitality with scenic mountain views, a sauna wellness area, regional dining, and year-round outdoor recreation.
